result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now works as a second name for `updateLandscape`. Both names go through the same code, so the options and behaviour are identical. The `cli` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or try either command, so the `-help` output and the `_sokrates_landscape/config.json` / `index.html` creation are unchecked.

- **`Commands.java`:** I added the `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` name and description. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. `analyzeLandscape` is also listed in the no-argument usage overview, sharing `getUpdateLandscapeOptions()` with `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`:** `run` sends both names to the existing `updateLandscape(args)`. In that method, `-help` prints the usage for whichever name you typed.
- **`README.md`:** it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Command line" section. It lists `init`, `generateReports`, `analyzeLandscape`, `updateLandscape` (noted as the same command, kept for existing scripts) and `updateConfig`.
- **`CLAUDE.md`:** the command list now reads `analyzeLandscape` (alias: `updateLandscape`).
